prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1037; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival at the intersection in Pasadena, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle rear-end collision involving a sedan and a pickup truck traveling in the same direction on the main roadway. Traffic was moving at a reduced speed due to congestion ahead. Driver 1, operating the sedan, stated that traffic slowed suddenly and that Driver 2, operating the pickup truck, was unable to stop in time, resulting in contact with the rear of the sedan. Driver 2 stated that the sedan stopped abruptly and that he was following at a reasonable distance. Visible damage was present to the rear bumper and trunk of the sedan and the front grille of the pickup. A Passenger in the sedan was present and was not reported to have been injured. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and declined transport by EMS at the scene, stating a intention to seek medical evaluation later. No citations were issued at the time of the report pending further investigation. Both vehicles were drivable and were moved to the shoulder of the roadway.
